typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		RECORDID as string,
		LOGMESSAGE as string,
		APPLICATIONNAME as string,
		VENDORSURVEYID as string,
		QUESTIONTEXT as string,
		QUESTIONNO as string,
		CREATEDATE as timestamp,
		{Action Item} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @STARTDATE DATETIME = ?, @ENDDATE DATETIME = ?  IF @ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = GETDATE()  IF @STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SELECT @STARTDATE = MAX(CreateDate) FROM PROCESSLOG WHERE LogMessage = \'ProcessVendorResults_new\' AND MessageType = \'Start\' SELECT DISTINCT  	CASE  		WHEN LEN(LOGMESSAGE) > LEN(REVERSE(RIGHT(REVERSE (LOGMESSAGE), LEN(LOGMESSAGE) - NULLIF(CHARINDEX(\' \', REVERSE(LOGMESSAGE)),0)))) 			THEN SUBSTRING(LOGMESSAGE, LEN(REVERSE(RIGHT(REVERSE (LOGMESSAGE), LEN(LOGMESSAGE) - NULLIF(CHARINDEX(\' \', REVERSE(LOGMESSAGE)),0))))+2, LEN(LOGMESSAGE)) 		END  AS RECORDID, 	LOGMESSAGE, 	M.APPLICATIONNAME, 	S.VENDORSURVEYID, 	SQ.QUESTIONTEXT, 	CASE  		WHEN SQ.QUESTIONNO IS NOT NULL  			THEN SQ.QUESTIONNO  		ELSE CASE  			WHEN LogMessage LIKE \'%Invalid Question%\'  				THEN RTRIM(LTRIM(LEFT(RIGHT(LOGMESSAGE,24),4)))  			ELSE NULL  			END  		END AS QUESTIONNO, 	P.CREATEDATE, 	CASE  		WHEN LogMessage LIKE \'%Invalid Question%\'  			THEN \'This Error indicates that Quesion number for survey results is either missing, invalid or does not exist. Solution is to update surveyquestions of the Application\\VendorSurveyID\' 		WHEN LogMessage LIKE \'%Invalid SURVEYID%\'  			THEN \'This Error indicates that Vendor Survey ID for the surveys results is either missing, invalid or does not exist. Solution is to check with Eliza for Incorrect SurveyId on their end or Updated SurveyId in Retention DB\' 		WHEN LogMessage LIKE \'%Invalid VENDOR SURVEY ID%\'  			THEN \'This Error indicates that Vendor Survey ID for the surveys results is either missing, invalid or does not exist. Solution is to check with Eliza for Incorrect SurveyId on their end or Updated SurveyId in Retention DB\' 		WHEN LogMessage LIKE \'%Invalid Record ID%\'  			THEN \'The record ID is invalid i.e. The record ID does not exist in Retention system\' 		ELSE NULL 		END AS [Action Item] FROM [RETENTION].dbo.PROCESSLOG P 	LEFT JOIN [RETENTION].DBO.MASTERRECORDS  M ON CASE WHEN LEN(LOGMESSAGE) > LEN(REVERSE(RIGHT(REVERSE (LOGMESSAGE), LEN(LOGMESSAGE) - NULLIF(CHARINDEX(\' \', REVERSE(LOGMESSAGE)),0)))) 	THEN SUBSTRING(LOGMESSAGE, LEN(REVERSE(RIGHT(REVERSE (LOGMESSAGE), LEN(LOGMESSAGE) -      NULLIF(CHARINDEX(\' \', REVERSE(LOGMESSAGE)),0))))+2, LEN(LOGMESSAGE)) 	END=M.RECORDID 	LEFT JOIN RETENTION.DBO.SURVEYS S ON M.APPLICATIONNAME=S.SURVEYNAME  	LEFT JOIN RETENTION.DBO.SURVEYQUESTIONS SQ ON S.SURVEYID=SQ.SURVEYID AND  RTRIM(LTRIM(LEFT(RIGHT(LOGMESSAGE,23),4)))=SQ.QUESTIONNO WHERE  MESSAGETYPE=\'ERROR\' 	AND P.CREATEDATE BETWEEN @STARTDATE AND @ENDDATE  ORDER BY  P.CREATEDATE  DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(VENDORSURVEYID_Unicode = toString(VENDORSURVEYID),
		QUESTIONNO_Unicode = toString(QUESTIONNO),
		QUESTIONTEXT_Unicode = toString(QUESTIONTEXT),
		CREATEDATE_Unicode = CREATEDATE,
		APPLICATIONNAME_Unicode = toString(APPLICATIONNAME),
		LOGMESSAGE_Unicode = toString(LOGMESSAGE),
		RECORDID_Unicode = toString(RECORDID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
